title: Incident
description: Incident record (spec/lifecycles/incident.md). Only the core opens it, by a code alarm and a catalog class (MGR-8); only code sets resolved; only a person sets dismissed, with a reason code and a "Details" text, which the core shows only to people and does not pass into model context. Code builds the list of involved parties with catalog functions, at most 20 targets. For a class with stops_manager whose subject is a disk, the record keeps a reason code in stops_manager_effect if there is no seat stop (GOV-22, MGR-33, MGR-34). No bot creates, changes or hides the record (GOV-13).

tenant.description: Tenant of the incident; for incidents with the subject farm this is farm.

class.description: Name of the incident class (metadata.name of the IncidentClass file, MGR-7).

severity.description: Severity; only a person can change it.

kind.description: Kind of the incident subject by the class's subject.kind.

id.description: Object id from the restricted character set [a-z0-9:_.-]{1,64}: catalog name, resource, task type, worker, task.

origin.description: code: a measurement by the core or a job role over farm series; monitor: a job role raised the alarm from a monitoring system problem (MON-5).

monitor_event.description: Problem number in the monitoring system for origin: monitor.

alarm.description: The code alarm that opened the incident.

implicated.description: Involved parties: workers and tasks that the class functions returned; code recomputes the list once a minute while the incident is open.

worker.description: Object id from the restricted character set [a-z0-9:_.-]{1,64}: catalog name, resource, task type, worker, task.

task.description: Object id from the restricted character set [a-z0-9:_.-]{1,64}: catalog name, resource, task type, worker, task.

stops_manager_effect.description: For a class with stops_manager: a reason code why there is no seat stop (the condition of MGR-33 or MGR-34 does not hold, the seat is not in held, the farm manager is disabled in the tenant).

ops.description: Control operations on the incident (C1 control.apply by the seat holder, or by people through P2 control.*) in the order of application: the operation from control-ops.yaml, its record and time.

id.description: The record the operation created (for example a stop).

by.description: Who applied it: the seat holder with an epoch, or a person.

humans_took.description: A person took on the incident (P2 incident.ack); the same as a non-empty taken_by.

taken_by.description: Which people took on the incident (P2 incident.ack), in the order of the marks.

details.description: The "Details" text typed by a person.

by.description: The person who dismissed the incident.

dismiss.description: Dismissal as false: only people see it, it does not go into model context.

closed_by.description: Who closed the incident after resolved: a person or the seat holder with an epoch.

dismiss_reason.description: Reason code for dismissing an incident from the registry incident-dismiss-reasons.yaml.

actor.description: A person or the holder of the farm manager seat with the seat epoch.
